auditor: Independent auditor (NYC special education hearing orders)
title: Independent Auditor's Post Corrective Action Sixtieth Quarterly Report
plain_title: Fewer than 5% of special education hearing orders carried out on time
what_they_audited: The sixtieth quarterly report by the court-appointed independent auditor, Guidehouse, measuring whether the New York City Department of Education (DOE) carried out special education hearing orders on time. It covers orders issued from April 9 through July 8, 2024, with individual tasks, called Action Items, finally due between May 14 and August 12, 2024.
background: Advocates for Children of New York (AFC) and the law firm Milbank filed the class action L.V. v. D.O.E. in 2003 on behalf of parents of special needs children who won orders from Impartial Hearing Officers against the DOE but did not get them carried out fully and on time. A 2007 Stipulation and Agreement of Settlement requires an independent auditor to report each quarter on how much is Timely Implemented, meaning done within the time the order sets or within 35 days if it sets none.
